blocks.title: The real Boardmix whiteboard, in a panel beside the conversation
blocks.description: Sign in once and work on your boards without leaving Astravia: the panel is Boardmix's own web app, not a stripped-down reimplementation of it.
badges: Agent can open and route it

showcase.user_prompt: Take me to the Boardmix AI flowchart.
showcase.assistant_reply: Open there. Sign in and take over.

items.title: The product, not a copy
items.description: Canvas, templates, AI generation, comments and export are all the ones Boardmix ships. Interface updates arrive the moment Boardmix deploys them.

items.title: Sign-in you control
items.description: Log in on Boardmix's own page inside the panel. The session lives in this panel's storage, and the plugin never asks for or stores your password.

items.title: Reopens where you left off
items.description: The panel remembers the last Boardmix address it actually landed on and reopens there next time, within the Boardmix site.

items.title: Agent can route the panel
items.description: Six tools let the agent open the panel, jump to the workspace, recent files, blank board or an AI entry, and report what is on screen.

items.title: Falls back instead of dying
items.description: If the remembered address stops working, the panel tries the workspace root and then the site root, and only then offers a retry or your browser.

items.title: Popups go to your browser
items.description: Links that leave Boardmix open the way the site intends, so nothing is trapped inside the panel.

blocks.content: This plugin is a window onto a hosted product. Boardmix runs on its own servers: boards, assets and AI generation are processed there, not on your machine, and the panel needs a network connection to show anything.

items.title: Open the Boardmix tab
items.description: Use the Boardmix tab, or ask the agent to open it for you.

items.title: Sign in on Boardmix's page
items.description: The first visit shows Boardmix's own login page. Create an account or sign in there; the panel keeps the session from then on.

items.title: Work on your boards
items.description: Open a board from the workspace, start from a template, or use an AI entry to generate a first draft.

items.title: Ask the agent to take you somewhere
items.description: Say which part of Boardmix you want — workspace, recent files, a new board, AI PPT, AI flowchart or AI chat — and it will route the panel there.

blocks.content: What the agent cannot do: it cannot read the canvas, click inside Boardmix, generate an image or a deck for you, or export your file. Those actions happen on Boardmix's servers through Boardmix's own interface, so you drive them in the panel and the agent helps around them.

Boardmix's free tier is limited: currently three files, 150 canvas elements, and standard-definition export with a watermark. Paid plans are sold by Boardmix, and this plugin neither includes nor bypasses them.
